title: sphaeropteris novae-caledoniae
intro: Sphaeropteris novae-caledoniae, commonly known as the New Caledonian tree fern, is a species of tree fern native to New Caledonia in the Pacific Ocean. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Sphaeropteris novae-caledoniae are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
